verdict_text: NO. The regex `matrix_re` omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 6 of the 7 per-layer projections (q,k,v,gate,up,down) are cast to bfloat16, giving 96 bfloat16 tensors instead of the required 112 — violating Required Result item 1 and the "exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16" check. The script's own assertion (`== 96`) was weakened to match this bug rather than enforcing the spec's real 112 count, so it won't fail loudly as required. `model.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj.weight` will incorrectly remain float32 in the output.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
